title: Rig Zarya
text: Kola was not the only Soviet superdeep well. The published record lists others, in Azerbaijan, in the Urals and in western Siberia, all part of a long state program to study the deep crust. Their depths and dates are public. Rig Zarya is not among them. Its name survives only on a chiselled brass plate and in a set of log books carried out of a cavern no survey shows. The logs use program forms and program units. The depth column runs past every well in the record, and the last entries are written in a different hand.
teaser: A Soviet rig that is in no record kept on drilling.
